SERVICE 02.A / CONSULTING

Hands-on AI advisory.
Not slide-decks — actual deliverables.

Structured methodology + industry case library + AI co-pilots — turning "can AI help us / how / where to start" into executable answers within 4-6 weeks. The first phase (discovery) is free.

01 / Who it's for

Not every company
should adopt AI.

✓ Good fit

  • Mid-market: ¥50M-¥500M revenue, with internal decision authority
  • 3+ years of accumulated knowledge (docs / customer files / process records)
  • Identifiable bottleneck — or knowledge-loss risk — in a core workflow
  • A decision-maker willing to invest 1-2 deep interview sessions

✗ Not a fit

  • Goal is "we want a chatbot" with no further depth
  • Budget under ~¥100K — can't even fund a real pilot
  • No real internal data — AI is just a marketing line
  • Expect ROI within 1-2 weeks
02 / Deliverables

Six concrete artifacts,
each immediately usable.

01 / DIAGNOSIS

Workflow diagnosis

Current-state diagrams of 3-5 key workflows + pain-point localization + data-flow audit. Pinpoints "where AI can wedge in."

~25 pages · with interview appendix
02 / ROADMAP

AI transformation roadmap

Phased: what to ship at 3 / 6 / 12 months. Each phase tied to verifiable outputs.

Gantt + milestones
03 / PILOT

Smallest-viable pilot design

One business line + one team + 8-12 weeks, with success metrics and a kill criterion.

Pilot SOW
04 / STACK

Tech-selection matrix

Open-source vs commercial vs in-house — three-axis comparison with a compliance-aware recommended bundle.

Matrix + scores
05 / TEAM

Team configuration

Roles needed during pilot + hire / contract / upskill paths. And the roles you don't need.

JD templates + hour estimates
06 / RISK

Risk + red-line list

Data security, compliance, model interpretability, org friction — surfaced upfront with mitigation plans.

Risk matrix + playbook
